Nexus Ventures

A new approach to venture investing

Next-generation venture funds — an exclusive Nexus development. Your capital joins a basket of the 50 most popular crypto assets. Every day a leading asset stands out; our AI reallocates hourly to capture performance.

Expected returns start from 15%+ per week, using an institutional approach: Nexus participates in the same shared exchange order book as major players such as BlackRock, MicroStrategy, Fidelity and peers. When these institutions move together, they shift the market — and Ventures is positioned inside that flow.

This fund is available from a Ventures balance of $200,000 and above.

Funding converts from your Merchant cold wallet (spot) into USD cash inside Nexus Ventures. You can withdraw Ventures USD back to your main cash balance anytime.
